edits.headline: China and North Korea open long-delayed border bridge
edits.subheadline: China is keen to strengthen trade ties with North Korea through the New Yalu River Bridge, the South China Morning Post reported.
editorialBody: China and North Korea opened a long-delayed border bridge, AFP and France 24 reported. China is keen to strengthen trade ties with North Korea through the New Yalu River Bridge, the South China Morning Post said.
The US is considering easing sanctions on shadow fleet vessels to cut freight rates, an official said, the New York Post reported.

Brooklyn prosecutors took down 112 servers behind a crypto scam targeting Russian speakers, Decrypt reported. The founder of Hyperliquid wants US oversight of trading platforms but not of his blockchain, CoinDesk reported.
The game Big Walk skipped Xbox as a boycott of Microsoft's involvement with Israel, The Verge reported.
In Israel, Netanyahu and Eisenkot clashed over Palestinian statehood ahead of elections, Middle East Eye reported.
In India, Gen Z protesters found gaps in a security clampdown, France 24 reported. In Colombia, people fearing for the future marched against the country's right-wing president, AFP reported.
A man killed by a tiger had climbed two fences before suffering multiple injuries, an inquest heard, BBC News reported.
